response.jobDescription:
• Experience

    • 6–8 years of overall IT experience, with a minimum of 6 years of hands-on experience in UiPath development.

  • Key Responsibilities & Technical Skills

    • Advanced hands-on experience in UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, Action Center, UiPath Apps, and Modern Activities.
    • Strong expertise in designing and developing enterprise-grade RPA solutions using UiPath.
    • Strong experience with REFramework is mandatory.
    • Experience in Database Automation, API Automation, Document Understanding, and reusable/custom activities.
    • Good programming/scripting knowledge in C#, .NET, VB/VBScript, and Java.
    • Experience with UiPath Orchestrator, including deployment, scheduling, monitoring, queues, assets, and automation management.
    • Experience with Action Center and Action Center Modern Activities.
    • Knowledge of UiPath Test Automation is an added advantage but not mandatory.
    • Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable and maintainable RPA/automation solutions.
    • Create and maintain project documentation, including PDDs, User Stories, As-Is and To-Be process documents, and solution design documents.
    • Provide solution design and technical recommendations to customers and stakeholders.
    • Work closely with Business Analysts, customers, developers, and Operations teams throughout the automation lifecycle.
    • Participate in requirement gathering, solution design, development, testing, and UAT activities.
    • Support customers during UAT, deployment, and rollout phases and coordinate with Operations teams for production deployment.
    • Provide production support and troubleshooting for deployed automations as required.
    • Follow RPA development standards, coding best practices, exception handling, logging, and reusable component development.
    • Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.
    • Demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Preferred Skills

    • Experience working in enterprise/client-facing RPA projects.
    • Experience in mentoring junior developers and providing technical guidance.
    • UiPath certifications are an added advantage.
